title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E09 — Matanzas
The Geckos are going after Amaru, as she plots to regain her true form and open the gates of Hell.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E10 — Dark Side of the Sun
As Kate nears death, the team races to defeat Amaru and seal the gate to Xibalba.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E10 — Sylvester Stallone
Stallone takes a seat in the Director's Chair.

title: The King of Fighters
description: Members of three legendary clans fight battles in other dimensions.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: Bangkok Dangerous
description: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

title: From Paris With Love
description: Two agents. One city. No mercy.

title: The Crow: Salvation
description: To avenge their deaths, a mystical crow resurrects an innocent young man who was executed for the murder of his lover.

title: The Forbidden Kingdom
description: The path is unsafe. The place is unknown. The journey is unbelievable.

title: Warrior
description: An Iraq War veteran (Tom Hardy) finds himself on a collision course with his estranged brother (Joel Edgerton) when both set their sights on winning a tournament in mixed martial arts.

title: The Iron Claw
description: The true story of the Von Erich brothers, who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

title: Hands of Stone
description: Coached by legendary trainer Ray Arcel (Robert De Niro), Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán (Edgar Ramírez) develops a fierce rivalry with American fighter Sugar Ray Leonard (Usher Raymond IV).

title: Lord of War
description: A relentless Interpol agent tracks an arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) trying to stay one step ahead of his business rivals.

title: Maximum Conviction
description: Tom, former black ops operative, and his partner Manning are forced to defend a prison when a force of mercenaries assaults the facility to find two women.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E03 — Quentin Tarantino - Vol. 1
Rodriguez interviews his long-time friend and co-collaborator, Quentin Tarantino; the pair discuss screen writing, camera placement and various film genres.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E04 — Quentin Tarantino - Vol. 2
Quentin Tarantino continues discussing his career and various aspects of directing.

title: Wild Card
description: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: Sharknado
description: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks.

title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
description: A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
description: While visiting an excavation site in Kenya, a former priest sees signs of demonic possession.

title: Force of Execution
description: A crime boss (Steven Seagal) needs the help of his former protégé (Bren Foster) to deal with a threat (Ving Rhames) to his empire.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E02 — Pre-Production Begins
Pre-production forges on as the filmmakers are forced to make huge decisions regarding everything from props and gear, exposing who has the experience when it comes to production, and who could fall behind.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E03 — Casting Actors
Casting proves to be difficult as Alejandro's main actor unexpectedly drops out of the film, forcing him to rethink the role; Scarlet succumbs to the stress of finding talent that will work under her budgetary restraints.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E02 — Guillermo Del Toro
Director Guillermo Del Toro discusses his career from artist to director/producer and his films.
